messages:
Lina (AE): Heads-up: Alpina Finance (EU) wants SOC2 Type II evidence + ISO27001 certificate copy for our POC. They also need a signed pen-test attestation and explicit confirmation of EU-only processing for the trial. They asked for a 3-week Dedicated quote with burst to 80 RPS. Can SE + Security help compile artifacts and a price appendix?

Arun (SE): Quick things we need: 1) Do they require full vuln report or just attestation? 2) log retention length? 3) KMS/HSM required? Also which model/quant setting will they run in the POC so we can scope the pen-test?

Priya (Security): We can provide: - SOC2 Type II scope summary (redacted) - ISO cert copy (as we hold) - Pen-test attestation letter signed by Head of Security. We do not disclose full reports publicly; full test reports can be shared under NDA. Confirm: recipient for attestation and whether they need vendor name in letter. Typical turnaround 3 business days after approval.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Pricing ballpark: for 4x A100-equivalent Dedicated pool ~ $15,500/mo. Pro-rated for 3 weeks = $10,875. Burst line for 80 RPS add-on typically $2,000 one-time credit. If they want short term hosted instead, estimate depends on token volume. Need expected qps, seq-len, and model: recommended to include model hash.

Lina (AE): They asked for 180-day logs retention and customer-managed KMS (HSM). Legal recipient: security-legal@alpina-fin.com. They want the attestation on our letterhead. They prefer attestation only, not the full report.

Nora (Legal): We will sign an attestation that a 3rd-party penetration test was completed and that there were no outstanding critical vulns at time of attestation. We cannot include raw vuln data; if they need full report they must sign an NDA and provide a contact. I'll need the exact attestation wording and approver name.

Priya (Security): Draft attestation (copy below). Please confirm customer name and approver. We will reference the vendor by name and redacted findings clause.

```
Penetration Test Attestation
Date: <DATE>
To: Alpina Finance / security-legal@alpina-fin.com
This letter attests that Redwood Inference engaged an independent security firm, <VENDOR>, to perform a penetration test of the Redwood inference service and related customer-facing controls covering network, API, and deployment configuration during <START> to <END>. The assessment included the customer-supplied model artifacts <MODEL LIST> and quantization profile. All critical findings were remediated prior to this attestation. Vulnerability details are redacted and are available to Alpina under a mutual NDA.
Signed,
Priya - Head of Security, Redwood Inference
```

Marco (Solutions Eng): For EU-only processing: we will pin the POC to eu-west-1 and restrict routing. Example SOW snippet to include: 
```
deployment: dedicated
region_restrict: [eu-west-1]
data_residency: eu
kms: customer-managed (HSM supported)
log_retention: 180d
model: redwood-llm-8b-q4_k
artifact_hash: <HASH>
```
Also need to know whether the POC will stream logs to their SIEM or we push S3 artifacts.

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-210 and SALES-POC-487 for attestation and ISO/SOC evidence handoff (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-210).

Arun (SE): Noted model redwood-llm-8b-q4_k and seq-len 2048. We'll include quantization and artifact hash in scope. For the pricing appendix I'll include: monthly list, pro-rated term, burst credit, and optional monitoring add-on.

Priya (Security): A couple policy notes: - We cannot reference raw vendor findings in the public letter. - If customer requests the vendors internal methodology details, we require a signed NDA + formal request. - Pen-test attestation will reference model name but not contain internal model weights or hashes in the public letter; hashes can be shared under NDA if required.

Lina (AE): Great. I'm uploading the PO now (will paste it here). Please attach the attestation + SOW appendix to the PO and loop Legal for signature.

Nora (Legal): Will review attestation. Please cc me when Priya posts the official draft; I'll run signature through the legal approver chain.

Marco (Solutions Eng): I'll post the SOW appendix and a concise cost table in ~45m.

Priya (Security): Targeting signed attestation within 3 business days after PO and approver name provided.

Lina (AE): Thanks all. I'll update Alpina Finance and confirm whether they'll execute the NDA for the full report if requested.
